meta.name: render-airdrop-carousel
meta.description: Assemble a viral iOS "AirDrop" notification-carousel video ad (≈6–8s, 9:16) from a brand line plus 6–16 real product photos — a native AirDrop share-sheet card ("Brand would like to share a ___ · Decline / Accept") springs up and its preview window CYCLES through the products, landing on a range/lineup payoff with an Accept tap; a chime + soft per-swap ticks track the swaps. DETERMINISTIC assembly — an HTML card (real DOM text) rendered to PNG via headless Chrome, chroma-keyed, its magenta window refilled per-product in PIL, then animated + audio-synthed with FFmpeg. FREE (no paid model calls); the recipe supplies the brand line, product images, and payoff and gates the only optional paid step (a hero shot when the brand has NO usable photo → create-image-fal). Use for the airdrop-notification-carousel format.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将品牌文案和产品照片合成为病毒式AirDrop通知轮播视频广告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速生成iOS AirDrop风格的轮播视频广告来推广产品线。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate iOS AirDrop-style carousel video ads for product line promotion.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据品牌名称和6-16张真实产品照片，自动生成一段约6-8秒的iOS AirDrop通知轮播视频广告。视频模拟手机收到AirDrop卡片，卡片预览窗口循环展示产品，最后显示产品系列并模拟点击“接受”。整个过程无需付费AI模型调用。
howto.when: 当你要求制作AirDrop通知轮播格式的广告视频，并提供品牌名称和至少6张真实产品照片时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个AirDrop轮播广告，品牌是“香薰小铺”，产品照片有这些。
用这些产品图生成一个AirDrop通知视频，最后一张展示全系列。
say.note: Claude会以最后一张作为系列收尾，模拟点击接受。
